output.summary: A herbaceous perennial flowering plant, it is eaten in spring as a leafy vegetable, pie filling and ingredient in broths and stuffed leaves in parts of Europe. Its leaves may be eaten raw or cooked but contain oxalic acid and should not be consumed excessively.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are eaten raw or cooked, especially in spring, but contain oxalic acid and should not be consumed excessively.
